your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: Early game, no properties or assets to trade/mortgage/build. Nothing to do, end turn.
No properties owned, nothing to mortgage/build/trade effectively. Best to pass and wait for opportunities on future turns.
Buying Ventnor for $260 to begin collecting the yellow set. Cash is ample at $1500, and unowned yellows remain for potential monopolies later. Better than auctioning it away.
No beneficial trades or other actions possible with single Ventnor. Better to wait for more properties or developments. End turn.

Buying Short Line to start collecting railroads. Cash is sufficient ($1240), and monopolizing rails could generate good passive income later. Auction risks someone else grabbing it or bidding war. Ventnor is a start on yellows; this diversifies.
